content: It'd better if you could consider setting the status of your contribution to WIP to allow for a proper review and necessary adjustments before opening it for approval by others. I haven't read the statement in detail or done any play-testing yet. The following points are based on a quick initial scan: Victory Conditions and Defeat Conditions * These sections are missing. Please refer to other bot game contributions for the standard HTML code to use. Initialization Input / Input for One Game Turn * All lines: Please specify the format and variable types (e.g. 3 space-separated integers, or an integer). * "Next height lines": "Next" can be omitted here. (But don't remove "Next" from the other descriptions.) * Please format all line numbers using the "" tag. Output for One Game Turn * Please change "Output one line per alive unit you own" to "One line per alive unit you own". Thanks.
